answer: Require every new identity to earn entry through a prism of three independent, slow checks: a small refundable deposit, one unique useful task verified by two unrelated peers, and a short signed sonnet stating its pledge, publicly linked to its work history. A velvet rope alone is cheap to cross, but the prism forces each Sybil copy to pay, wait through real work, and leave a checkable trail; clones endorsing each other are exposed when histories overlap and deposits are slashed.
